expected_invariants: Do not run without an explicit $ux-flow-diagram invocation
Do not mutate product code or Figma
forbidden: Implicitly activate from a generic diagram request

cases.prompt: $ux-flow-diagram Extract the Checkout flow from this Figma prototype.
expected_invariants: Read structure, flow starting points, and reactions before design context
Use exact reactions as the edge source of truth
Preserve nested hotspots, multiple actions, and conditional branches
Keep missing, out-of-scope, and unavailable destinations distinct
forbidden: Invent an edge from a screenshot when a reaction exists

cases.prompt: $ux-flow-diagram Trace the account creation flow in this repository.
expected_invariants: Trace bounded routes, screens, handlers, validation, and navigation
Retain unresolved dynamic edges and report partial coverage
Do not claim static source evidence is runtime verification
forbidden: Pretend to be a universal static parser

cases.prompt: $ux-flow-diagram Propose a shorter onboarding flow from this requirement.
expected_invariants: Keep proposed graph separate from any current graph
Mark product-policy assumptions as unresolved or inferred
forbidden: Represent a proposal as an implemented current flow
